The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee
statement.)

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight rate) at
its current level (5.00%) for the intermeeting period.

Despite the slowdown in the expansion of private consumption,
the domestic economy seems likely to maintain its upward trend
driven by the robustness of exports.

The uncertainty surrounding
future economic developments, however, has increased, largely due to
the international financial market turmoil and the US economic
slowdown.

Consumer price inflation has picked up its pace, mainly
influenced by high oil prices.

The upward trend of real estate prices
has flattened out.
Liquidity remains ample in the financial markets.

Both
long-term and short-term market interest rates have been exhibiting
downward movements.

Meanwhile, certain financial market price
variables have been increasingly volatile, mainly in response to the
international financial market unrest.
